rule: A Lean proof establishes a mathematical consequence of a definition. It is never evidence that APGI describes the brain. 'empirically-supported' requires a cited dataset and a pre-registered prediction ID.

claims.text: Raising θ cannot make ignition easier at fixed S.
The clamped update preserves the positivity floor θ_floor (0 AU by default).

The θ₀ band [0.25, 0.85] AU is not an invariant of the clamped update for unrestricted targets; it is invariant when targets lie in the band and 0 ≤ g ≤ 1. Consistent with the Notation Appendix: θₜ may leave the band transiently.
a < 0 is necessary for cusp bistability (and hence hysteresis).
Three distinct cusp equilibria exist if and only if 4a³ + 27θ² < 0 (which forces a < 0).
claims.note: Sufficiency proved first (cusp_three_equilibria); the converse (task 28) makes it an equivalence. Twins: test_cusp_three_equilibria, test_cusp_three_equilibria_converse, test_cusp_discriminant.

claims.text: Forward-Euler relaxation stays in bounds when Δt ≤ τ.
APGI's hysteresis prediction (Innovation 4) holds in human data.
κ (ATP per bit of ignition-event information) has no canonical value; published sensitivity calculations span 3 × 10³ to 10⁹ ATP/bit.
claims.note: Replaces the draft claim 'κ ≈ 1,700, dimensionless overhead'. Uncalibrated by the corpus's own statement (Notation Appendix p22).

claims.text: The exact exponential decay (Math Spec Eq. 32) keeps θ inside any interval that contains θ and θ₀, for every step dt ≥ 0, with no step-size condition.
The hazard sampler is dt-invariant: n steps of dt have the same survival probability as one step of n·dt, and the per-step probability lies in [0, 1] and rises with the propensity Bₜ.
claims.note: Backs PD-HAZARD. Per-step Bernoulli(Bₜ) sampling is not dt-invariant (test_per_step_bernoulli_is_not_dt_invariant).

claims.text: Raising θ cannot raise the per-step ignition probability under the hazard with logistic propensity.
The exact leaky-integrator gain λ = 1 − exp(−dt/τ_S) lies in (0, 1) for dt > 0; the integrator stays inside any interval containing S and S_inst and is dt-invariant under constant input.
The NE clamp enforces |γ_NE|·g_NE ≤ 0.5 for either sign of γ_NE, keeps 1 + γ_NE·g_NE in [0.5, 1.5], and so never drives a positive threshold to zero.
The canonical threshold step (Eq. 26, exact decay, floor) respects θ_floor; with δ_reset ≥ 0 an ignition never lowers the next threshold, and with η_θ ≥ 0 a larger C − V never lowers it.
Ψ(z) is strictly bounded by max(α⁺, α⁻); with α⁺ = α⁻ and γ⁺ = γ⁻ it reduces to α·tanh(γ·z), which is odd.
With β_SM ≥ 0, Πⁱ_eff is non-negative and non-decreasing in M̂(c,a); the hard clamp keeps it in [Π_min, Π_max].

The canonical drive Π_rel·(|z| − m₀) is monotone in Π_rel if and only if |z| ≥ m₀; below m₀ it is strictly decreasing, so more precision on a smaller-than-expected error makes ignition harder. Equal-magnitude errors of opposite sign contribute equally.
m₀ = E|z| = √(2/π) for a standard normal z (∫|x|e^{−x²/2}dx = 2).
Bₜ = 1/2 at S = θ_eff for every γ_sig; as γ_sig → ∞ the propensity tends to 1 above and 0 below threshold, recovering the strict hard threshold.

In the canonical step, θ_eff enters the successor state only through the sampled event B(t); the next θ is computed from the state θ; one ignition adds exactly one δ_reset (decayed once), one δ_ref and one retention.
For a < 0, three cusp equilibria exist iff |θ̃| < 2(−a/3)^{3/2}; past the ignition or extinction fold the system is monostable.
The learning rule contracts the prediction error for 0 < η_pred·Π < 2; the dopamine bias raises salience exactly while zⁱ > −β_DA/2.
Divisive normalization keeps a budget of 2, reduces to the core at equal gains, and lowers exteroceptive gain when interoceptive gain rises.

Inside the Paper 3 dimensionless gains (C_down·τ_Π ≤ 0.5, C_up·τ_Π ≤ 0.2) and γ_ψ ≤ 3 the loop gain is below 1; the former production defaults give 2 × 10⁴ and the adopted scaled couplings give 0.02. This is a design heuristic, not a stability proof.

Urgency is non-negative, non-decreasing and vanishes at u_max = 0; P(report) lies in [g, 1 − λ_lapse] and rises with P(hit); the geometric and continuous timescale forms hit their endpoints and are monotone; ψ is bounded and odd; Γ = R² ∈ [0, 1]; aggregation stays between the extreme level drives; the hierarchical target stays in [0.5, 1.5]·θ₀,ℓ.
Lyapunov conjecture (SSOT §12.5): V = Σ_ℓ[(Π_ℓ − Π_ℓ*)² + (θ_ℓ − θ_ℓ*)²] satisfies V̇ ≤ −λV with λ ≥ min(1/τ_Π, 1/τ_θ)·(1 − loop gain). Not proved; needs the closed-loop linearization.

Estimator rules: ε is antisymmetric and vanishes at x̂ = x; z vanishes at μ_ref, is odd about it and monotone in ε; α_EMA ∈ (0, 1); the EMA mean stays between μ and ε; the variance stays non-negative and only shrinks for a sample at the mean (mean-centred, not E[ε²]); Π_rel = 1 at Π̄ and inherits the clamp scaled by 1/Π̄.
The soft floor σ(−γ_sig·θ_eff) is ≤ ε iff γ_sig·θ_eff ≥ log(1/ε − 1), so a floor ≤ 0.01 needs γ_sig·θ_eff ≥ log 99; the step rule dt ≤ τ/10 implies the forward-Euler bound.

Between events the continuous threshold form (and its reduced measurable form) is solved by θ* + (θ(0) − θ*)e^{−t/τ} with θ* = θ₀ + τ·D; T_ant = 0 recovers the reactive cost; V ≥ 0, C is monotone in the previous ignition, and more information value never raises the next threshold.

The precision-ODE rate is strictly decreasing in Π_ℓ and reduces to pure decay without drive or coupling; level salience is sign-symmetric under the symmetric Ψ and monotone in the gate; a synchronized Kuramoto level drifts at ω; the tanh reservoir state is bounded and its readout is non-negative.

E_L(310 K) = k_B·310·ln 2 lies within 0.5% of 2.97 × 10⁻²¹ J, and the 300 K value is below 2.88 × 10⁻²¹ J; κ = E_event/(N_b·|ΔG_ATP|) ≥ 0; R_L ≥ 1 iff E_event ≥ N_erase·E_L. These are unit and arithmetic facts, not measurements of neural efficiency.
